comparison.objective: Open a locker while supporting a case leaning on its door, then place the case upright; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Maintain hidden-load support through door opening, transfer grasp, and upright placement versus recessed-key work, collar tuning, and dynamic inspection.
comparison.success_condition: Case never tipped or dropped and ends standing released on the mat versus two safe impact cycles and post-lock setting stability.
comparison.reason: The record tests support removal and load handling rather than adjustment; all six versions were read and their differing drop rule was considered.
